paraphrase: Accommodation fees are recognized when the facilitation obligation is satisfied at check-in.
Stays of at least 28 nights have monthly contracts: first-month revenue at check-in, later months at monthly anniversaries.
Revenue is net service fees; cleaning fees and taxes are excluded.
Collected pre-check-in service fees are refundable unearned fees; host disbursement follows check-in.
Non-USD-functional subsidiaries translate income at period averages and balance sheets at closing rates.
Monetary remeasurement uses closing rates; nonmonetary remeasurement uses historical rates; remeasurement gains and losses enter other income/expense.
Guest and host currencies can differ; payment timing creates currency exposure, including confirmed unbilled payment-program bookings.
GBV includes host earnings, fees, cleaning and taxes; cancellations and alterations reduce their processing period.
Entire booking value enters GBV when booked, irrespective of payment; RNPL requires no booking payment and has higher historical cancellations.
RNPL delays collection toward the stay; customer funds do not affect FCF except their interest.
Constant-currency growth translates current foreign-currency revenue using comparative-period exchange rates.
Revenue hedge losses were $19M in Q2 and $34M in H1 2026.
About $26M of deferred losses were expected in revenue over the next twelve months; actual reclassification depends on exchange rates.
Outstanding designated FX hedge notional was $3.4B at June 30, 2026.
